column3: MT 3:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “how many are my opponents” is rendered “how my adversaries have increased.”
Close to the Hebrew; “behind me” is rendered “about me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I called out” is rendered “I was crying.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the jaw” is rendered “on the cheek.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB renders the nominal clause as a wish, “Your blessing be upon Your people!”
